RtcHandle.description: RTC peripheral handle in the ST HAL layout, filled by bms_rtc_hal_init at RAM 0x20005D00 and then passed to HAL_RTC_Init, HAL_RTC_GetDate, HAL_RTC_GetTime, HAL_RTC_SetDate and the RTC wake-up helpers. Only the fields written by bms_rtc_hal_init are identified here; the rest of the HAL structure is not in this packet.

fields.name: instance
fields.description: Pointer to the RTC register block (&RTC). bms_indirect_nibble_get dereferences this slot and returns the low nibble of the byte it points to.

fields.name: init_word_04
fields.description: Set to 0x8800 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Probably a control word of the HAL init block; its meaning is not established.

fields.name: hour_format
fields.description: Set to 0 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Probably the hour-format field (0 = 24-hour clock).

fields.name: async_prediv
fields.description: Asynchronous prescaler: 0x7C when the clock is LSI (bms_rtc_lse_selected flag 0) and 0x7F when it is LSE (flag 1). Probably divides to 1 Hz with the synchronous prescaler.

fields.name: sync_prediv
fields.description: Synchronous prescaler, set to 0xFF by bms_rtc_hal_init (probably 256 in the HAL, giving 1 Hz together with the asynchronous value).

fields.name: output_word_14
fields.description: Set to 0 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Probably the RTC output-selection field of the init block (no output used).

fields.name: output_word_18
fields.description: Set to 0 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Probably the output remap field of the init block.

fields.name: output_word_1c
fields.description: Set to 0 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Probably the output polarity field of the init block.

fields.name: control_word_20
fields.description: Set to 0x40000000 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Meaning not established in this packet.

fields.name: reserved_24
fields.description: Set to 0 by bms_rtc_hal_init. Meaning not established in this packet.

BmsTm.description: Broken-down calendar time (struct tm style, eight 32-bit words) written by bms_epoch_to_tm from a Unix epoch value. Weekday 0 is Sunday; year is counted from 1900 as in struct tm.
